passages.text: When a remark wounds your pride, pause before answering. Examine the judgment you added to what was said.
passages.raw_text: When a remark wounds your pride, pause before answering. Examine the judgment you added to what was said.
passages.authorship: Synthetic fixture author — not Marcus Aurelius

passages.text: An insult does not decide the next act. Answer with fairness when an answer is required.
passages.raw_text: An insult does not decide the next act. Answer with fairness when an answer is required.
passages.authorship: Synthetic fixture author — not Marcus Aurelius

passages.text: A calm response need not mean accepting injustice. Sometimes duty requires a firm objection.
passages.raw_text: A calm response need not mean accepting injustice. Sometimes duty requires a firm objection.
passages.authorship: Synthetic fixture author — not Marcus Aurelius

passages.text: Quiet is useful before a reply, but silence is not always a duty.
passages.raw_text: Quiet is useful before a reply, but silence is not always a duty.
passages.authorship: Synthetic fixture author — not Marcus Aurelius

passages.text: A thought can recur: wait, then look again. Another reminder says: wait, then look again. A café sign and a 🏛️ mark test exact positions.
passages.raw_text: A thought can recur: wait, then look again. Another reminder says: wait, then look again. A café sign and a 🏛️ mark test exact positions.
passages.authorship: Synthetic fixture author — not Marcus Aurelius

passages.text: A useful action does not need an audience. Choose the work that serves the shared task, even when no one will notice it.
passages.raw_text: A useful action does not need an audience. Choose the work that serves the shared task, even when no one will notice it.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: Your effort can be fair and careful even when the shared project fails. Failure changes what is possible next; it does not turn an unfair shortcut into a fair one.
passages.raw_text: Your effort can be fair and careful even when the shared project fails. Failure changes what is possible next; it does not turn an unfair shortcut into a fair one.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: Cooperation is not surrender of judgment. Refuse an unjust instruction without pretending that refusal ends every responsibility to the people involved.
passages.raw_text: Cooperation is not surrender of judgment. Refuse an unjust instruction without pretending that refusal ends every responsibility to the people involved.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: A sudden impression says that a setback is unbearable. The arrival of that impression is not yet a considered judgment that it must govern your next act.
passages.raw_text: A sudden impression says that a setback is unbearable. The arrival of that impression is not yet a considered judgment that it must govern your next act.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: The report and the judgment are different: a meeting was canceled, and you added that your worth was canceled with it. Examine the addition before consenting to it.
passages.raw_text: The report and the judgment are different: a meeting was canceled, and you added that your worth was canceled with it. Examine the addition before consenting to it.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: Pain is not refuted by describing a thought differently. Clear judgment can acknowledge injury and still ask which response is available.
passages.raw_text: Pain is not refuted by describing a thought differently. Clear judgment can acknowledge injury and still ask which response is available.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: You cannot reserve an unlimited future for the work you keep postponing. The time for acting fairly is the time that is available now.
passages.raw_text: You cannot reserve an unlimited future for the work you keep postponing. The time for acting fairly is the time that is available now.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: A reputation preserved after death is still made of other people’s changing judgments. Do not trade the whole present for that uncertain echo.
passages.raw_text: A reputation preserved after death is still made of other people’s changing judgments. Do not trade the whole present for that uncertain echo.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: A short life is not a reason to abandon a dependent person. The limit on time makes the question of what deserves attention sharper, not meaningless.
passages.raw_text: A short life is not a reason to abandon a dependent person. The limit on time makes the question of what deserves attention sharper, not meaningless.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: A plan is an attempt to act intelligently under conditions you do not fully command. Prepare the action without treating preparation as a promise from the world.
passages.raw_text: A plan is an attempt to act intelligently under conditions you do not fully command. Prepare the action without treating preparation as a promise from the world.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: When the result goes against your preference, ask whether the action was fair and what can now be done. An unwanted outcome does not by itself answer either question.
passages.raw_text: When the result goes against your preference, ask whether the action was fair and what can now be done. An unwanted outcome does not by itself answer either question.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: Acceptance of what has happened need not prevent a new attempt. Refusing to notice changed conditions is stubbornness, not constancy.
passages.raw_text: Acceptance of what has happened need not prevent a new attempt. Refusing to notice changed conditions is stubbornness, not constancy.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: Praise can be given for an unfair act and withheld from a fair one. A crowd’s approval therefore cannot be the final test of how you acted.
passages.raw_text: Praise can be given for an unfair act and withheld from a fair one. A crowd’s approval therefore cannot be the final test of how you acted.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: Someone’s criticism may expose a fact that your pride concealed. Inspect the fact before deciding that the speaker’s judgment has no value.
passages.raw_text: Someone’s criticism may expose a fact that your pride concealed. Inspect the fact before deciding that the speaker’s judgment has no value.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: You need not obey every opinion in order to learn from a true correction. Refusing all feedback makes reputation into an enemy to fight rather than an uncertain external judgment.
passages.raw_text: You need not obey every opinion in order to learn from a true correction. Refusing all feedback makes reputation into an enemy to fight rather than an uncertain external judgment.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: One reflection grounds cooperation in a rational order that includes human beings as parts of a whole. Its practical recommendation is offered with a metaphysical premise.
passages.raw_text: One reflection grounds cooperation in a rational order that includes human beings as parts of a whole. Its practical recommendation is offered with a metaphysical premise.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: Another reflection asks how to act if events arise through chance rather than providence. The alternative does not become the same explanation simply because some advice remains similar.
passages.raw_text: Another reflection asks how to act if events arise through chance rather than providence. The alternative does not become the same explanation simply because some advice remains similar.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: Two arguments can converge on a practical act while disagreeing about why the world is as it is. Preserve the disagreement instead of announcing that the shared advice proves either premise.
passages.raw_text: Two arguments can converge on a practical act while disagreeing about why the world is as it is. Preserve the disagreement instead of announcing that the shared advice proves either premise.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: A person can act badly while believing the action good. Understanding that mistake changes how you approach correction; it does not make the action harmless.
passages.raw_text: A person can act badly while believing the action good. Understanding that mistake changes how you approach correction; it does not make the action harmless.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: You and the person who angered you share the capacity to misjudge. That kinship can limit contempt while leaving a firm objection available.
passages.raw_text: You and the person who angered you share the capacity to misjudge. That kinship can limit contempt while leaving a firm objection available.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: Protecting someone from harm may require resistance, a boundary or a refusal. Sympathy for the wrongdoer does not erase the claim of the person being harmed.
passages.raw_text: Protecting someone from harm may require resistance, a boundary or a refusal. Sympathy for the wrongdoer does not erase the claim of the person being harmed.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: An appetite is a reason to notice a desire, not an automatic order to satisfy it. Restraint can make room to ask what the situation requires.
passages.raw_text: An appetite is a reason to notice a desire, not an automatic order to satisfy it. Restraint can make room to ask what the situation requires.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: Practicing discipline for an audience changes the purpose of the exercise. The point is a more dependable action, not the appearance of severity.
passages.raw_text: Practicing discipline for an audience changes the purpose of the exercise. The point is a more dependable action, not the appearance of severity.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays

passages.text: A tired or injured body is part of the situation to judge. Deliberate conduct can include rest, treatment or asking for help rather than turning endurance into a spectacle.
passages.raw_text: A tired or injured body is part of the situation to judge. Deliberate conduct can include rest, treatment or asking for help rather than turning endurance into a spectacle.
passages.authorship: Original synthetic editorial example — not Marcus Aurelius or Hays
